Delta is expanding its summer 2027 schedule with seasonal service and additional weekend frequencies to popular leisure destinations across the U.S., Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean.
“We’re continuing to tailor Delta’s schedule around where our customers want to travel,” said Amy Martin, Vice President - Network Planning. “By adding weekend flights to some of the most sought-after leisure destinations across the U.S., Canada, Latin America and the Caribbean, we’re giving customers more flexibility and more ways to make the most of their summer.”

Delta’s expanded summer schedule also includes previously loaded weekend flights from Boston (BOS) and New York-LaGuardia (LGA).

More weekend options to Latin America and the Caribbean Delta is also expanding weekend flying to Latin America and the Caribbean for spring and summer 2027, with additional Saturday frequencies and extended seasonal service in 10 markets.

The expanded schedule will extend select seasonal routes further into the spring and summer while adding more Saturday options during peak leisure travel periods. The new Saturday frequency between Atlanta (ATL) and St. Lucia (UVF) will also provide enhanced connectivity for customers traveling through Delta’s Atlanta hub.
Flights are operated as a mix between Delta and Delta Connection.
